d:
After nearly three years in detention under the National Security Act (NSA), jailed Khadoor Sahib MP Amritpal Singh returned to his native village, Jallupur Khera in Punjab’s Amritsar district, on three-hour custody parole to attend his grandmother’s cremation.
He was brought from Dibrugarh jail in Assam under police escort, amid tight security.
Watch Ground Report by Mayank Kumar and Suraj Singh Bisht
